subject.title: fix(security): ignore string-literal contents in code-safety env/exfil rules (#82469)

question: After the interpolation-regex false negative is fixed, should OpenClaw accept env-harvesting-only string-literal masking as the code-safety scanner boundary?
rationale: The PR changes what a security audit heuristic can and cannot see, so tests can prove mechanics but not final security-boundary acceptance.

options.title: Fix then accept env-harvesting-only masking
options.body: Repair regex handling inside template interpolations, keep potential-exfiltration and payload rules unmasked, and merge after focused scanner validation.

options.title: Require parser-backed scanning
options.body: Pause this heuristic branch and ask for syntax-aware tokenization if maintainers want stronger scanner guarantees.
